utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — the top priorities are small fixes like loose handles, squeaky hinges, and a few patch jobs. We’re now set for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll let you know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — small fixes at the community center Sunday. Just keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Bo — thanks again for pitching in. I’ll send the final details if anything changes before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re gathering the tools first—hammer, screwdriver set, and any spare tape—then we’ll head to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds perfect—bring whatever you can, and I’ll keep a list of what’s still missing. I’ll be at the front porch Saturday for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver set if I can find them, and I’ll check for spare tape too. See you at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good—Saturday at the front porch works for me. Just send the final list when you’ve got it, and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: 8:30 at the community center, right after drop-off — that’s still the plan, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — could you also include the start time and where people should leave the items? I’m worried folks will show up at the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll make sure to include the start time and tell everyone to leave items at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I can help with the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch. Just let me know what you need me to do.

utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Sam—please help remind neighbors about the repair drive and point out the biggest repairs first. If anything changes, let me know; I might miss it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Noah—I’ll remind neighbors and highlight the biggest repairs first. I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.text: Oren: Starts at 3, right? I think they’re taking boxes and spare parts, and maybe a few more donations too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, 3 o’clock sounds right. I can swing by late and help spread the word about boxes, spare parts, and any extra donations.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, thanks. I’ll be there at 3 with the boxes and spare parts, and we can take any extra donations too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Uli—I'm gathering helpers for the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch. If you can spread the word or lend a hand, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I can help for a bit if we keep it low-key, and I’ll spread the word when I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Uli—thanks! Keep it low-key, and I’ll make sure people know we’ve got a repair drive this Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, do you know when the repair drive starts, and is there a flyer with the items they’re taking?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the details first—do you know what time the repair drive starts, and can you tell me which items they’re accepting?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m not sure yet—do you have the start time and the list of accepted items?

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Gus — we still need a hammer, any spare tape, screws, and maybe some glue. I’ll check what we’ve got on hand too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a hammer, some tape, and a box of screws too. I’ll see if I have any glue and drop it off Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — just keep me posted as soon as those two roles are set so I can plan the timing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia — I’ll let you know as soon as those two roles are assigned for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — I appreciate it. Just send me the details as soon as they’re set so I can line up the timing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details first—what time does the repair drive start, and which items are they accepting?

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Rey—really appreciate it! See you Saturday at the front porch for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — that really helps. See you at the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Rey — I’m glad you can make it. I’ll keep a spot for you at the front porch Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still waiting on the time and the load list for the repair drive. Once you have those nailed down, I can note it down.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m still pinning those down for Saturday at the front porch—I’ll send the time and load list as soon as I’ve got them sorted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, Saturday at the front porch works for now—just send me the time and load list when you’ve got them sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, sounds like the repair drive is coming together. I heard they’re still collecting tools and spare parts, so if you see what’s left, I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Nell — I’ll check what’s still needed and let you know. If you hear of any other tools or spare parts, just pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check our supplies and see what I can round up for the repair drive—tape, screws, glue, and a few basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll go by the repair drive and see what’s still needed, then I’ll tell you the latest so you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks—I’ll be at pickup until around three, so just let me know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — I’ll do that. If you stop by Saturday, I may need to remind you of the porch details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, I probably will need that reminder. I’ll swing by Saturday if I can, and keep me posted on the porch details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — I’ll keep it low-key and let you know the porch details if you stop by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal—do you know when the repair drive starts, and is there a flyer with the items they’re taking?

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ll be there at 3 to help move the boxes. If you need the spare parts list or flyers, I can send those over too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren—that would be a huge help. Please send the spare parts list and flyers over when you can, and I’ll have everything ready for 3.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll send over the spare parts list and flyers soon. See you at 3 for the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We still need to gather the tools first—hammer, screwdriver set, and any spare tape. After that, we can head to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few more donations today. I can keep an ear out for any extra tools while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira—that would help a lot. If you spot a hammer, screwdriver set, or any spare tape, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We’re starting at the front porch this Saturday. Just bring whatever tools you’ve got, and I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm—front porch this Saturday, right? And you want me to bring whatever tools I have.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, that’s right — front porch this Saturday, and any tools you can bring would help. Thanks, I’ll handle the rest.
